purpose: Independent practice of letter-sound mapping in CVC words.
student_learning_goal: I can map letters to sounds in CVC words.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can map letters to sounds in CVC words.
header.character_watermark: Blendy the Bear in the top-right with a sound-blending strip and letter cards. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a line from each letter to its SOUND.
parts.visual_layout: Four letter cards on the left and four phoneme bubbles on the right with a connecting space for drawing match lines.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 letter-to-sound match layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. Left column: 4 letter cards (lowercase: c, m, s, t). Right column: 4 phoneme bubbles labelled /c/, /m/, /s/, /t/. Space between for student to draw match lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P1_LETTER at Part 1: keywords name the letter cards and sound bubble match task.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 pictures, write the letter that makes each sound.
parts.visual_layout: Four picture icons each above a 3-cell sound box for the child to fill in letters.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 letter-build layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. 4 pictures (cat, dog, sun, mat) each above a 3-cell sound box. Boxes are large enough for letters. Pictures share a baseline with the boxes.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_BUILD at Part 2: keywords name the picture-and-build sound box task.

parts.answer_key: cat: c-a-t; dog: d-o-g; sun: s-u-n; mat: m-a-t.

parts.student_instructions: Read each word in the sound boxes. Circle the picture that matches.
parts.visual_layout: Three rows, each with a sound box word on the left and three picture choices on the right to circle.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 read-and-match layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. 3 rows. Each row: 1 sound-box word on the left (PIN, CUP, RUN) and 3 picture choices on the right. Children read the word and circle the matching picture.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P3_READ at Part 3: keywords name the read-the-word and circle-picture match task.

parts.answer_key: PIN→pin picture, CUP→cup picture, RUN→running figure picture.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, build a NEW CVC word in your own sound box (write the 3 letters).
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Formative — confirm child uses SOUND (not name) when reading letter cards aloud.
